business_problem: Rentokil Initial manages a dynamic workforce of over 65,000 colleagues worldwide. While the company has built its collaborative foundation on Google Workspace since 2008, leadership recognised a vital opportunity to modernise the daily workflows of its frontline technicians.
solution_summary: Scaled "On The Go" application across multiple markets with approx 20,000 technicians and sales people Rentokil Initial manages a dynamic workforce of over 65,000 colleagues worldwide. While the company has built its collaborative foundation on Google Workspace since 2008, leadership recognised a vital opportunity to modernise the daily workflows of its frontline technicians. Historically, technicians often had to manually dig through siloed systems and legacy documents just to piece together a customer's site history. Rentokil Initial partnered with Telana to deploy a Gemini-powered assistant that provides field technicians with hands-free, real-time service and customer data. A Rentokil Initial technician using the Gemini Live conversational audio feature inside his vehicle to safely review site histories on the go.
